description: Start confirming a phone number or email as a test recipient. A 6-digit code is sent to it. Once confirmed, test messages to that recipient really arrive (otherwise test mode only logs them in a sandbox). Only add numbers or emails that belong to the account owner. Test key (sk_test_) only. After calling this, ask the human for the 6-digit code they received and call confirm_test_recipient.

to.description: Israeli mobile number in E.164 format +9725XXXXXXXX (05XXXXXXXX is also accepted), or an email address for the email channel.

name: add_test_recipient
